status.description: Free text. If you send no status at creation, the server sets `Backlog`.

teams.description: The ids of the teams that work on the project. An empty list means that the project belongs to all the teams.

capabilityIds.description: The capabilities that the project builds or changes.

401.description: The request has no valid token or session.

404.description: A team or a capability is not in the workspace

409.description: A project with this name is in the workspace already
